name: 092-scale-50mp-planroom
description: 50MP A0-class plan sheet: 20px em notes and 18px em mono schedules at native detail; 0.475x single-pass downscale drops them under 10px em, the regime segmentation exists to save.
expected_text:
SITE PLAN SP-04: QUAYSIDE ENERGY CENTRE
Scale 1:200 at A0. Grid: local datum QEC-2026. Sheet 4 of 12.
GENERAL NOTES
1. All dimensions are in millimetres unless noted. Verify every setting-out dimension on site
against the QEC-2026 grid monuments before excavation. Report discrepancies over 15 mm to the
engineer before proceeding with the affected work.
2. Underground HV cable route 11kV-R2 crosses the northern access at chainage 48.20. Hand dig
within 1500 mm of the marked route. Cable cover tiles must be reinstated with warning tape at
300 mm above the duct crown.
3. Drainage runs DR-7 to DR-11 fall at 1:150 toward manhole MH-19. Invert levels are tabulated
on sheet SP-09. Flexible couplings within 600 mm of every structure face, both sides.
4. The attenuation tank base slab is cast on 50 mm blinding over compacted type 1 fill at 95
percent modified proctor. Waterstop at every construction joint; the kicker pour includes the
north wall starter bars.
SETTING OUT TABLE
Point ST-01: E 4821.440  N 9310.220  cover level 5.840
Point ST-02: E 4874.905  N 9310.220  cover level 5.815
Point ST-03: E 4874.905  N 9268.130  cover level 5.760
Point ST-04: E 4821.440  N 9268.130  cover level 5.790
Benchmark TBM-2: brass stud in fuel store plinth, level 6.112
EARTHWORKS
Strip topsoil to 300 mm and stockpile on the western bund at a maximum height of 2.5 metres.
Cut material classified 2C may be reused in landscape mounding north of gridline 14 subject to
moisture conditioning between 12 and 16 percent.
Excavations deeper than 1200 mm require trench support to the temporary works designer's
details. Groundwater strike below 4.1 metres was recorded in borehole BH-06; allow for sump
pumping in the tank excavation.
DOOR AND GATE SCHEDULE
G-01 sliding gate  6000 x 2400  powder RAL 7016  motor DK-9
G-02 swing gate    1200 x 2400  powder RAL 7016  keyed alike
D-01 fuel store    1000 x 2100  steel FD60       panic bar
D-02 switchroom     900 x 2100  steel FD60       louvre 600
D-03 control room  1000 x 2100  timber FD30S     vision panel
FENCING
Perimeter fence type F2: 2.4 metre paladin mesh on 60 x 60 SHS posts at 3.0 metre centres, set
750 mm into C20 concrete. Three lines of barbed tape above the switchyard section only, per the
security consultant's memo SC-11.
Acoustic barrier along gridline 2 from chainage 0 to 64: 3.6 metre absorptive panels, minimum
surface density 20 kilograms per square metre, colour to match RAL 7035. Posts designed for a 3
second gust of 24 metres per second.
SERVICES CROSSING NOTES
Telecoms duct T-4 enters the site under the eastern verge at 900 mm depth and rises into
cabinet CAB-2. Maintain 300 mm clearance from the LV route and 500 mm from drainage crossings.
Marker posts at every change of direction.
REVISION TABLE
P1  2026-05-02  first issue for comment            KMB
P2  2026-06-18  tank moved 1.2 m north, note 4     KMB
C1  2026-07-30  issued for construction            RGA
C2  2026-09-12  gate G-01 motor spec revised       RGA
QUAYSIDE ENERGY CENTRE
Drawing SP-04 revision C2. Drawn KMB, checked RGA, approved TW.
Meridian Consulting Engineers, 22 Quay Road, Boston. Job 26-118.
